name: Beast 3
source:
One day Mr. Sato rang saying that he felt foggy. When Soga and Kotone made it to his place, the man was missing. First step is to seek at university where he was last seen.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/06/vn-of-month-january-1993.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
某天，佐藤先生打来电话，说自己感觉头脑昏沉。曾我与琴音赶到他家时，佐藤却已不知所踪。调查的第一步，是前往他最后一次露面的大学寻找线索。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/06/vn-of-month-january-1993.html]vndbreview[/url]]
